summary: Rebrandly merged with IntelligenceBank to form Radiate, joining content approval with branded links, link tracking and attribution in one company. Both brands keep selling separately.
LTK creators can now tag LTK product links straight into Instagram Reels, posts and carousels through Meta's new Add products feature.
Beacons added tools to track brand-deal exclusivity periods, contract terms and deadlines. More YouTube Shopping Australia (with Amazon) coverage landed.
Lasso, URLgenius and Amazon's own tools were quiet; Button only shared a conference soundbite.

items.title: IntelligenceBank and Rebrandly Merge to Form Radiate, the Content Lifecycle Company for the AI Era
items.why: A link-tracking company is joining up with a content approval tool, so links become part of a bigger 'from brief to result' system. Link tools keep being bundled into larger marketing platforms.
